purpose: Quality attribution from one immutable split-safe cloned constructor; paired LOO versus independent state baseline, no resource penalty.
notes: Generate the clean initialization with constructor_clone.py using the manifest train/validation split, teacher-mode monotone and no legacy warm start with unknown lineage ancestry.
Keep the same initial policy, datasets, support, STOP bias, reward, rollout count, optimizer and evaluation budget across baseline variants.
The state critic is training-only. A zero output head begins at ordinary LOO; any gain must be measured, not assumed.
Study execution snapshots every initial checkpoint; separate --only launches reuse the same content-addressed input.
Full-host P16/Z15 and congested P6/Z4 remain the paper benchmark axes. This small cell is a mechanism/pilot gate.
These configurations and unit tests do not establish quality superiority.
The clone initialization already carries its learned STOP/RESTART logits; stop_bias=0 preserves them instead of adding the initialization bias twice.
